task.instructions:
Using matplotlib, create a pie chart from these synthetic trip records. Each record lists district, day type, travel mode, and trip count. Multiple records for the same mode are separate batches and should be added together.

Central, weekday, Bus, 20
Central, weekday, Bus, 40
Central, weekday, Bicycle, 10
Central, weekday, Bicycle, 20
Central, weekday, Walking, 4
Central, weekday, Walking, 6
Central, weekend, Bus, 90
Central, weekend, Bicycle, 5
Central, weekend, Walking, 5
West, weekday, Bus, 10
West, weekday, Bicycle, 80
West, weekday, Walking, 10

Keep only weekday records from Central. Sum the trip counts by travel mode and calculate each mode's percentage of the total trips in those retained records. Draw one slice per mode. Label each slice with its mode and percentage to one decimal place. Use blue for Bus, orange for Bicycle, and green for Walking. Use the title 'Weekday travel in Central' and equal axis scaling so the pie is circular. Use a 6 by 5 inch figure at 150 DPI. Keep all text fully visible and readable, and save figure.png.

I need to create a Python script that processes the given synthetic trip records, filters the data to retain only the weekday records from the Central district, sums the trip counts by travel mode, calculates the percentage of each mode, and generates a pie chart with the specified requirements. Let me create this script now.

function.arguments:
{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_pie_chart.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Data provided in the task
data = [
    ("Central", "weekday", "Bus", 20),
    ("Central", "weekday", "Bus", 40),
    ("Central", "weekday", "Bicycle", 10),
    ("Central", "weekday", "Bicycle", 20),
    ("Central", "weekday", "Walking", 4),
    ("Central", "weekday", "Walking", 6),
    ("Central", "weekend", "Bus", 90),
    ("Central", "weekend", "Bicycle", 5),
    ("Central", "weekend", "Walking", 5),
    ("West", "weekday", "Bus", 10),
    ("West", "weekday", "Bicycle", 80),
    ("West", "weekday", "Walking", 10)
]

# Filter data: Keep only weekday records from Central
district = "Central"
day_type = "weekday"
filtered_data = [record for record in data if record[0] == district and record[1] == day_type]

# Sum trip counts by travel mode
mode_counts = {}
for record in filtered_data:
    mode = record[2]
    count = record[3]
    mode_counts[mode] = mode_counts.get(mode, 0) + count

# Calculate total trips
total_trips = sum(mode_counts.values())

# Calculate percentages
percentages = {mode: (count / total_trips) * 100 for mode, count in mode_counts.items()}

# Prepare data for pie chart
labels = list(mode_counts.keys())
sizes = list(mode_counts.values())
colors = ["blue", "orange", "green"]

# Create pie chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5), dpi=150)
ax.pie(sizes, labels=labels, colors=colors, autopct=lambda p: f'{p:.1f}%', startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})

# Equal axis scaling to make the pie circular
ax.axis('equal')

# Set title
ax.set_title('Weekday travel in Central', fontsize=14)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('figure.png')
plt.close()

print("Pie chart saved as figure.png")
EOF"}
